data.businessDescription: Aumovio SE engages in development, manufacture and distribution of assembly parts, system components and complete systems for all kinds of vehicles (Autonomous Mobility, Architecture and Network Solutions, Safety and Motion, User Experience, Contract Manufacturing). Spun off from Continental; founded August 6, 2024; HQ Frankfurt.

Betsson AB is holding company, which engages in the investment in online gaming companies. It offers casino, sportsbook, and other games via gaming licences in countries in Europe, and Central Asia. It operates through the Betsson, Betsafe, Casino DK, Guts, Jackpot247 and Europebet brands. Founded 1963, HQ Stockholm.

GlobalData Plc engages in the provision of business information, research services, and marketing solutions. The firm offers report store, intelligence center, and consulting services. Segments: DA&I Healthcare and DA&I Non-Healthcare. Founded 1999, HQ London.

KION GROUP AG engages in the sale and distribution of industrial trucks (forklifts, warehouse technology, financial services) and supply chain solutions (integrated technology and software to optimize supply chains). Founded 1819, HQ Frankfurt.

TUI AG engages in the provision of tours, hotels and resorts, and cruise services. Segments: Hotels and Resorts, Cruises (TUI Cruises JV, Hapag-Lloyd Cruises, Marella), and TUI Musement. Founded 1923, HQ Hannover.

SBM Offshore NV provides floating production solutions (FPSOs) to the offshore energy industry. Segments: Lease and Operate (day rates on long-term operating leases) and Turnkey (supply contracts and after-sales). Founded 1965, HQ Schiphol.

data.businessDescription: J Sainsbury Plc engages in the retailing, financial services, and property investment businesses. Segments: Retail-Food, Retail-General Merchandise and Clothing (Argos), and Financial Services. Founded 1869, HQ London.

NOS SGPS SA is a holding company providing television, internet, and telephone services (Telco) and Audiovisuals (content distribution, movie theaters, pay TV rights) in Portugal. Founded 1999, HQ Lisbon.

Metropole Television (M6 Group) provides audiovisual media, radio broadcasting (RTL), and digital streaming (M6+, Bedrock) services; free-to-air TV channels and advertising sales via M6 Publicite. Founded 1986, HQ Neuilly-sur-Seine.

Repsol SA engages in exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas, refining, petrochemicals, trading, customer (service stations, power and gas), and low carbon generation. Founded 1927, HQ Madrid.

data.businessDescription: Heineken Holding NV engages in the management and supervision of the Heineken group, and production and distribution of beer and other beverages (Heineken, Amstel, Birra Moretti, Cruzcampo, Desperados, Dos Equis, Sol, Tecate, Tiger, Strongbow etc.) across Europe, Americas, Africa/Middle East/Eastern Europe, Asia Pacific. Founded 1952, HQ Amsterdam.
Colonial SFL SOCIMI SA engages in the real estate business, managing and developing rental office buildings in Barcelona, Madrid and Paris (SFL). Founded 1946, HQ Barcelona.
Attendo AB engages in the provision of private care services: care for older people, people with disabilities, and individual and family care, in Scandinavia and Finland. Founded 1985, HQ Danderyd.

Cadeler A/S is a supplier to the offshore wind industry of installation services and operations and maintenance works using wind farm installation vessels; also construction and decommissioning. Founded 2008, HQ Copenhagen.

Glenveagh Properties Plc engages in the construction and sale of houses and apartments in Ireland. Segments: Suburban, Urban, and Partnerships (with government and local authorities). Founded 2003, HQ Maynooth.

Dole Plc engages in the distribution and marketing of fresh fruits and vegetables: Fresh Fruit (bananas, pineapples from Latin America), Diversified Fresh Produce EMEA, Diversified Fresh Produce Americas and ROW, and Fresh Vegetables. Founded 2017, HQ Dublin.

Tessenderlo Group NV provides chemical solutions: Agro (crop nutrients and protection), Bio-Valorization (animal by-products, collagen/gelatin), Industrial Solutions (plastic pipes, water treatment chemicals), and T-Power (CCGT power plant). Founded 1919, HQ Brussels.
Develia SA engages in real estate development in Poland: Rental Services, Property Development Activity, and Holding Activity. Founded 2006, HQ Wroclaw.

data.businessDescription: Air France-KLM SA provides passenger and cargo air transportation services, aeronautics maintenance, and low-cost (Transavia) activities. Founded 1947, HQ Paris.

Hugo Boss AG is a fashion and lifestyle company offering women's and men's apparel under BOSS and HUGO brands, plus licensed fragrances, eyewear, watches and children's fashion. Founded 1924, HQ Metzingen.
